title: the drone comes down to the water
the glassy stare and the sun on his skin
he looks across at the coop
the fist, and falling in love
he wipes it and goes to the water
slimy feathers and the big eyes
out of the water and up the ladder
she lowers her head and he reaches behind him
the ring in the leaf box
she swallows it and walks past him
he turns and watches her go
she stoops and pecks him once
onto her back, and the run for the door
the run out of the hen house
